The cartridge keeps one copy at arm9:0x020072c0, owned by src/_ZN7Vector3D1Ev.cpp; this object's copy is the identical 4-byte `bx lr` body and no surviving section here references it. deadstrip-duplicate makes rombuild compare this body against those cartridge bytes before dropping it; plain deadstrip is the one disposition never compared against the cartridge.
